title: CTA state 'correction' -> direction
hypothesis: In the 'correction' state (12-month leg up, 1-month down) the next 20-day move relative to the 12-month trend differs from other days (two-sided).
source: Agent 8 CTA state; MOP (1-12 month persistence)
flag_doc: agent 8 CTA state == params.state (correction: 12-month leg up, 1-month down; rebound: the reverse); side = the 12-month sign

recall_probe.question: Before the run: will the effect have the registered sign and pass the gate?

llm_window: LLM-in-sample: 1206 of 1206 episodes fall before the drafting model's boundary 2026-10-16; the model picked no number; the flag rule came from the literature and predates this test
audit_subject: CTA state 'correction' -> direction cta_state correction flag
data_note: Outcomes use agent 8's spliced daily returns (Yahoo front-month closes, roll jumps screened against a spot or index proxy where one exists; markets without a proxy keep unadjusted roll days).
